$comment: Toybox Trials asset manifest. Concept art is reference only and stripped from production builds. World models/textures/audio are code-generated; production UI icons and gameplay tutorial screenshots are recorded below.

folders.concepts: Art-direction reference images. Never loaded by the game.
folders.environments: Production environment assets (room-layer GLBs such as the dog; optional low-end room plate). Empty: the room is built and lit in code (src/scene/Room.tsx, src/scene/room/).
folders.characters: Production character assets. Empty: the contender is built procedurally (src/character/WindupBot.tsx).
folders.props: Production prop assets. Empty: all props are code-built primitives (src/scene/*).
folders.ui: Production UI images, including transparent Spellbox ability icons and real gameplay tutorial screenshots; other UI uses CSS and inline SVG.
folders.audio: Production audio files. Sound effects and music are synthesised at runtime (src/game/audio.ts, src/game/musicScore.ts, src/game/music.ts), including the three Music Box Rhythm tracks and the calm background music. audio/voice/ holds recorded voice lines (<line id>.mp3, script in src/game/voiceLines.ts, docs/VOICE.md), each with its own entry here with "file": "audio/voice/<id>.mp3". Recorded so far: Pipwick's welcome tour.
folders.thumbs: Game-card thumbnails (480x270 WebP): original captures of real gameplay from this build, made by tests/e2e/thumbs.cjs and tests/e2e/thumbs.py. Cards fall back to the trial accent colour when one is missing.

conventions.units: 3D world units are centimetres (1 unit = 1 cm); the contender is 3.5 cm tall.
